limitations: Technical scores are normalized to 0-100 and are not final option-aware production scores.
Historical option selection and historical account risk decisions cannot be evaluated from underlying bars alone.
Underlying replay does not apply the live bot same-candidate suppression cache.

replay_scope.note: The original replay included 74 extended-hours iterations per symbol pair using prior-session RTH candles. Live entries scan only while the Alpaca market clock is open.
